schemaBoundary.whyNotSwitchToVersion2: The closed standalone schema requires schemaVersion 2, artifactDirectory = '.', batch-local paths without '..', and complete batch membership. Native structure validation also requires campaignGoalCount and resolution count to equal batchGoalIds length. A one-goal carryover bound to an intact historical 20-goal dual summary does not satisfy that standalone contract. Changing the schema version would require materially different artifacts or weakened validation, neither of which is needed here.
